answer: A concrete defense is a slashable, sequential uniqueness path. Each new identity locks a jade bond and then computes an address-bound challenge whose next step requires the previous output, so clones cannot share the work. A rotating panel rechecks published checkpoints the way a ranger rechecks a timber blaze on one trail rather than a stack of copies. Colliding traces burn both bonds, and the cluster is treated as many stems from one yarrow root, with later payouts clawed back. Extra masks then cost their own time, capital, and audit risk.
